_comment: Single source of truth for feature flags. Consumed by the Python backend (dbcore/feature_flags.py) and the Qwik frontend (apps/web). `default` is the fail-safe used when PostHog is unreachable or the flag is undefined there; self-host (no POSTHOG_API_KEY) enables everything unless a flag sets `self_host` explicitly (used by inverse-polarity flags like site-building, where ON hides the product). Keys must match the PostHog feature flag keys exactly.

site-building.description: Site-wide building/under-construction curtain. ON = whole web UI shows the building page. Redirect service and API are unaffected. Inverse polarity: OFF is normal operation.

signups.description: New account registration. Login is NEVER gated.

link-creation.description: Creating new short links. Existing links always redirect.

custom-slugs.description: Vanity slugs on link creation (paid feature).

billing.description: Paywall, checkout and /billing/offerings. The RevenueCat webhook is NEVER gated.

early-access.description: Early access mode. ON = every account gets the enterprise limits for free, plan/billing surfaces are hidden and an early-access notice is shown. OFF = plans and limits are enforced as configured.

projects.description: The public /projects section (things built with 3m4). OFF hides the nav links and the pages render a coming-soon state.
